propositions: The rebar-gerrit-voter-errors alarm fires on isolated transient self-healing errors that do not require operator intervention, causing noise and false pages

The alarm must be recalibrated to distinguish transient markers (clearing within one 5-minute interval) from sustained failure modes (continuous marker stream across consecutive periods) to reduce false positives

The 3-of-5 sustained-detection shape (evaluation_periods=5, datapoints_to_alarm=3, threshold=0, Sum>0) allows isolated markers and boundary-straddling transients to not page while firing within ~15 minutes of a stuck gate (expired token, LLM outage, Gerrit unavailable)
The alarm description must be updated to document the sustained-failure calibration rationale and ticket reference per fail-closed design rationale
Manual terraform apply is required via infra/runbooks/provision-restore.md plan-before-apply workflow; the daily terraform-drift sweep flags the pending change until applied
